name: fetch_news_article
description: Fetch the full body of a single news article by its provider code and article id. Use this after fetch_news returns a headline list — each headline carries provider_code + article_id which feed this tool. Returns {:article-type (0=text, 1=HTML, 2=binary) :article-text :provider-code :article-id} or :unavailable.

provider_code.description: News provider code from the headline (e.g. "BRFG", "DJNL").
